description: This file defines the BufferStream class implementing the StreamInterface, providing buffer management with read/write capabilities and high water mark handling within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: A buffer stream class that allows writing to and reading from an internal buffer, with support for high water mark metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes BufferStream with an optional high water mark (default 16384).

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a string.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the buffer contents.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and returns null.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is always readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is always writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the position to the start by seeking to 0.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws exception; position cannot be determined.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads specified length from the buffer, removing it.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer; returns false if buffer exceeds high water mark.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns high water mark if key is 'hwm', otherwise null or empty array.
